The Digital Fairness Act (DFA) is a legislative proposal by the European Commission . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Michael McGrath , EU Commissioner for Democracy, Justice, the Rule of Law and Consumer Protection , is responsible for this class of legislation under Ursula von der Leyen 's second Commission . [ 3 ] The proposed legislation aims to tackle dark patterns , personalisation , contracts, and influencer marketing . [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ]
